text:
The night splintered into stars

looking at me hallucinated

the air throws hatred

its face beautified

with music.


Soon we shall leave


Arcane dream

ancestor of my smile

the world is gaunt

and there is a padlock but no keys

and there is terror but no tears.


What shall I do with myself?


Because to You I owe what I am


But I have no tomorrow


Because to You I...


The night suffers.

translation.title: Ashes
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the broken invocation to You and the abrupt ellipsis before the final line.
